## Evidence and review

- [ ] New or changed substantive propositions have source IDs.
- [ ] Official sources are used where available and source tiers are accurate.
- [ ] Source locators/excerpts are precise and minimal.
- [ ] Verification dates and freshness intervals are justified for current reviewed evidence.
- [ ] Local/specialist review questions remain visible where unresolved.
- [ ] Any material reviewer conflict is disclosed below.

## Safety boundary

- [ ] This change does not present personalized legal eligibility or a guaranteed route.
- [ ] This change does not submit or automate government filings.
- [ ] This change does not instruct evasion of tax, registration, disclosure, sanctions, AML/CFT, fundraising, or other controls.
- [ ] This change contains no passports, signatures, beneficial-owner records, or other sensitive personal/incorporation data.

## Validation

- [ ] `python scripts/validate_corpus.py`
- [ ] `python scripts/check_freshness.py`
- [ ] `pytest`
- [ ] `python packages/schemas/export_json_schema.py --check`
